source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Απριλίου — «Άγιος Μάξιμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole body is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Μάξιμος μαρτύρησε αφού του διαπέρασαν την κοιλιά με ξίφος» — he was martyred after they ran a sword through his belly. No century, no place, no persecutor, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. The paragraph under the name heading, about a philosopher of Tyre of the second century after Christ and a philosopher of the fourth before, is saint.gr's gloss on the name Μάξιμος and is not about the martyr. **The display name is dated because the line gives nothing else to tell him by**: the corpus holds sixteen other men of this name — of Ozovia, of Moscow, of Totma, the Confessor, the Greek, the Soldier and the rest — and none of them is a bare Maximus killed by a sword through the belly on 30 April. It prints no hymn and names no relic.
